By default, returns only the authenticated user's own favorites — this applies to admins too, so "GET /favorites" always means "my favorites", never "everyone's favorites". Admins who explicitly want to see ALL users' favorites (e.g. for an analytics/dashboard view) can pass ?all=true. Regular users cannot use this flag; it's silently ignored for them.
